_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a SNES project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project is one cartridge, with its MSU1 audio pack if it has one. The pack's files must keep the names the cartridge expects. The .msu data file and the -N.pcm tracks start with the same name as the ROM file, and that is how Snes9x finds them.

slots.title: Cartridge
slots.help: The Super Nintendo or Super Famicom cartridge ROM.

slots.title: MSU1 audio pack
slots.help: The files of the MSU1 add-on, for a cartridge that uses it. They are the .msu data file and the audio tracks -1.pcm, -2.pcm and so on. Their names must start with the cartridge's file name (rom.msu, rom-1.pcm ...), because that is how the machine finds them. With no pack the cartridge runs as it does on a console that has no MSU1.
